\chapter{Methodology}\label{sec:method}
We define the objective
\begin{equation}
  f(x) = \frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n} (x_i - \bar{x})^2 \label{eq:objective}
\end{equation}
and minimise Equation~\eqref{eq:objective} over $x \in \R^n$\index{objective}.
